why: Your add: a pagoda match, and very cute. The pinks, lime greens and teals are all there; no forest green, but a lot of colour range in the greens.

Your add ("How could we forget?!"): the pagoda ties in, and while the tiles are brighter than Darjeeling, it has the greens. The mat is a chameleon with its infusion of bright blue and a pink inner border. Retired.
Your add: a pink centre for her pink faces and a turquoise-and-teal frame for her layers, with leafy blossom branches; the blue band and peach lattice are extra colours, and there's no forest green.
Your add: chartreuse and mint like her layers, pink brushstrokes and pagoda lanterns, though the blue lanterns and cranes make it lighter and sunnier than her forest-green backs.
Your add: the deep green frame and kelly centre carry her Forest Green Jade backs, and the blue-and-teal peacocks pick up her teal layer; almost no pink, so the faces bring it. Retired.
